name: Patisserie 46
whatItIs: French bakery and patisserie founded by chef John Kraus; sister shop Rose Street Patisserie in St. Paul.
evidence: Own site advertises Thanksgiving preorders and Galette des Rois preorders; a Jan. 22, 2026 Counselor Realty guide lists Tuesday-Sunday hours.

name: Rose Street Patisserie
whatItIs: Sister patisserie of Patisserie 46, French breads and pastries.
evidence: Shares the Patisserie 46 site, which lists Rose Street hours and location and current seasonal preorders.

name: Marc Heu Patisserie Paris
whatItIs: Paris-style patisserie run by Marc and Gaosong Heu; Marc Heu is a French-born Hmong pastry chef raised in French Guiana and trained at École Lenôtre.
evidence: Ramsey County podcast dated June 26, 2026 describes him sharing pastry at his St. Paul shop; Sahan Journal (2023) gives the Dale Street address.

name: Patrick's Bakery & Café
neighborhoodOrCity: Richfield, Edina (Southdale Square) and Maple Grove
whatItIs: French bakery-café ('We bring France to you!') with pastries, chocolates and bistro dishes.
evidence: Own site lists current locations and reservations, copyright 2026.

name: Trung Nam French Bakery
whatItIs: Longtime Vietnamese French bakery known for baguettes, pastries and banh mi.
evidence: Listed as a current winter favorite in a Jan. 22, 2026 Twin Cities guide.

name: Bûcheron
whatItIs: French-and-Minnesotan restaurant by Adam Ritter and Jeanie Janas Ritter; James Beard Award for Best New Restaurant, 2025.

name: Thérèse
whatItIs: Classic French bistro from chef Daniel del Prado.

name: Oh Crêpe!

name: Salut Bar Américain
whatItIs: French-American brasserie.
